problem: The public control row exposes a single Hint state/action. The app's merged assistance contract (gothic-cozy-puzzles#69) needs shared presentation for three tiers: free Nudge and Explain, and counted Reveal with honest pending, success, failure and exhausted states, without app-local duplicate UI.
solution: Add createAssistancePanel (content for the existing editorial bottom sheet), showAssistanceCue (the approved V4 hint-circle with the shared gameplay pulse, aria-describedby equivalent, reduced-motion static) and createAssistanceAnnouncer, exported from projects/grim-glimmer with styles in the existing project CSS. The control row is unchanged: its single Hint button opens the panel. The panel renders app-provided availability, guidance and Reveal allowance only; it rejects dishonest counts, never decrements, and shows no price or purchase action. Explain shows a Logic Library link only when the app passes a real destination. Feature Expansion stories use only the public barrel plus labelled fixtures.
tests: npm run check: lint, format:check, typecheck, vitest (55 files, 688 tests), build, publint + packed consumer smoke (extended with the new exports), build-storybook

tests/assistance-panel.test.ts: tier states, callbacks, honest-count validation, Reveal lifecycle, exhausted without purchase, Explain focus handoff and plain text, lesson link gating, cue semantics surviving updateBoard, pulse vs reduced motion/Animations OFF, announcer, single Hint entry point

Codex review fixes: Explain focus falls back to an enabled tier, then the section, when Explain is disabled as guidance closes; updateCluedBoard feedback no longer removes an assistance cue ring (tests fail before the fix, pass after)
Chromium/Playwright on the Storybook build: all 24 Assistance stories render and play functions pass
Chromium/Playwright 360x640 and 390x844 light/dark: no overflow, 44px targets, axe WCAG 2/2.1 AA no violations, cue animation present/absent under reduced motion (docs/assistance-evidence)
risks: Physical Android cue visibility and TalkBack listening are not measured; the approved ring is unchanged and may be judged too faint on device, which would need a reviewed option. Fixture Reveal success does not mutate the board. Mapping of app UnavailableReason and accounting-pending outcomes to panel text is documented but implemented by app #74. Additive public API only; no existing export changed.
review: Check that createGameControlRow is untouched and that no second Hint control exists; RevealPresentation validation and exhausted copy (no invented offer); focus moves to guidance and back to Explain; cue uses aria-describedby and never changes cell state; CSS uses theme tokens and the scoped [hidden] rule; stories import src/projects/grim-glimmer/index.js only for shared UI. paintBoardFeedback now skips .gg-v4-assistance-cue rings; feedback hint rings are still replaced as before.
